title: Chicken Bacon & Ranch Sliders
recipeCredit: Cookingwithmurph (Facebook Reel) — full recipe adapted from The Country Cook (thecountrycook.net)
ingredients: 12 Hawaiian Rolls, sliced in half lengthwise
1 pound sliced deli chicken (or rotisserie chicken, shredded)
2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley (or 1 tablespoon dried)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking dish or baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the bottom halves of the Hawaiian Rolls onto the prepared baking sheet.
Use a pastry brush to spread ranch dressing on both cut sides of the rolls (about 1/4 cup per side).
Layer on the bottom halves: sliced deli chicken, crumbled bacon, then shredded cheddar cheese.
Place the top halves of the Hawaiian rolls over the filling.
In a bowl, mix together melted butter, parsley, parmesan cheese, dry ranch seasoning, garlic powder, and dried dill.
Brush the butter mixture generously over the tops of the rolls.
Cover loosely with aluminum foil, making sure the foil doesn't touch the rolls.
Bake for 10-15 minutes until heated through and cheese is melted.
notes: Most ingredients available at Sam's Club per the original creator. Can substitute rotisserie chicken or leftover chicken for deli slices. Pre-cooked bacon crumbles from the salad dressing aisle save time. Can be assembled ahead and refrigerated — add butter topping just before baking and allow a few extra minutes of bake time.
